docs: Rating content: the score, a heading that names it, a line (the count, the scale) and the source as a link. One object is valid in every rating layout (a bar, centred).

value.docs: the score as it is shown (4.9, 98%)

description.docs: the count and the scale (out of 5, from 1,240 reviews); empty: none

sourceLabel.docs: the label of the source; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set
